commitment_grid_basis: The endpoints and quartiles form the preregistered five-point structural grid; four eighth-grid midpoints are preregistered resolution enhancement, never selected after observing policy switches.
commitment_application: chi applies only to each period's newly generated blocked cohort through q_committed=chi*q_blocked and q_decision=(1-chi)*q_blocked; existing waiting, maritime pipeline, and tagged queues are never relabelled
training_rule: BC teacher demonstrations and BC/constrained-SAC checkpoints are regenerated independently at every chi; the three deterministic seed indices are common across chi and validation precedes test evaluation

path_design.target_basis: Inherited 5.2.2 preregistered target: 5 percent of the 45112.7565 reference failure loss
path_design.required_count_formula: ceil((t_(0.975,N-1)*paired_sd/target_halfwidth)^2), bounded below by 88 and above only for execution by 196
path_design.common_count_rule: maximum required count over endpoint, policy, and Passive/Reactive reference contrasts; the selected count is used for every chi

inference.learning_seed_rule: average the three learning seeds within physical path before any inference
inference.multiplicity: Holm-adjusted p-values and Bonferroni simultaneous t intervals over each preregistered contrast family
inference.regret_definition: path-paired policy loss minus the minimum loss among the five main policies on the same physical path and chi
inference.confidence_set_rule: simultaneous differences from the sample leader; retain policies whose lower bound is not above zero

execution.parallel_workers_basis: independent policy-path replications use process isolation while reserving four of sixteen logical processors and memory headroom for orchestration
execution.cache_contract: cache is reusable only when the full config, upstream lock bundle, and selected production-source bundle hashes match
